blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Davao regional director of the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) on Thursday appeared before the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) to comply with the subpoena issued to her in connection with the bureau’s investigation into the flood-control projects in Davao. DPWH Regional Director Juby Cordon arrived at the NBI headquarters in Pasay City around 1 p.m., refusing to answer media queries.
